item.title: Morning brief, Thursday November 26
item.description: Good morning Sydney, and happy Thanksgiving. Before you open Instagram or TikTok, grab one cozy mountain-morning story while the light is pretty, and if the F1 Vegas recap still isn't posted, today's quiet morning is a great time to cut it and put it up. Your one big thing today is simply to be off and enjoy Thanksgiving with family. If the morning is slow, twenty minutes on that F1 recap is the flip option. A few quick must-dos if you have a minute: check ShopGoodwill, because the Versace satin pants payment was due last night and I don't see a confirmation yet, and you also won a cast iron tea kettle that needs paying within the week. Gabe sent a calendar invite for the Park Place lease extension in January, so accept it when you get a chance. Your schedule today is light: Thanksgiving from three fifteen to seven forty-five this evening, mountain time. The weather in Granby is sunny with a high near forty-seven, dropping to about fourteen tonight, so bring a warm layer. No flights today. Enjoy the day, you've earned it.
